# Script introduction

The obligate-rich regions are also the best known: 97% of the recorded species of Australia and 80% of southern Africa are classified, against 51–53% of the Holarctic, 15–34% of the tropics and 15% of the Neotropics (`s12`). Obligate associations are found by people who rear larvae, so the best-studied faunas might look the most obligate. This notebook tests whether the regional ordering of obligate shares could be an artefact of knowledge (big-picture plan, test E). For each region, the obligate share of its species is estimated in five ways:

1. **All classified species** (as elsewhere).
2. **Species-specific evidence only**: species whose type was recorded for the species itself, not presumed from relatives.
3. **Well-classified places only**: the species recorded in hexagons (about 210,000 km²) where at least half of the recorded species are classified.
4. **Unclassified species imputed**: every unclassified species given the obligate share of its classified congeners (or, without classified congeners, of its subfamily in its region), so the estimate covers all recorded species.
5. **Unclassified species obligate (upper bound)** for the poorly known regions only.

Finally, whether obligate species are better sampled than facultative ones, in GBIF records per species given region and lineage; if obligate species were the better known, knowledge could inflate their share.

A full run takes under a minute.

# Setup

## Packages

```{r load_packages, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(resrepo)
library(data.table)
library(mgcv)
library(ggplot2)
```

## Variables

```{r setup_variables}
min_completeness <- 0.5
min_recorded_hex <- 10
types <- c("n", "f", "m", "p")
specific_basis <- c("direct", "direct_class_inferred_subtype")
region_levels <- c("Nearctic", "Neotropic", "Palearctic", "Tropical Africa", "Southern Africa",
                   "Indomalayan", "Australia", "New Guinea and islands")
region_short <- c(Nearctic = "Nearctic", Neotropic = "Neotropics", Palearctic = "Palaearctic",
                  `Tropical Africa` = "Tropical Africa", `Southern Africa` = "Southern Africa",
                  Indomalayan = "Indomalaya", Australia = "Australia",
                  `New Guinea and islands` = "New Guinea")
estimate_levels <- c("All classified species", "Species-specific evidence only",
                     "Well-classified hexagons only", "Unclassified species imputed from relatives")
estimate_colours <- c("#3B3B3B", "#0072B2", "#009E73", "#E69F00")
```

# Obligate share of each region, five ways

*Inputs:* s05/ species_regions.csv, presence_hex5.csv, cell_data_hex5.csv; raw/butterfly_ant_interactions/species_table.csv
*Outputs:* knowledge_regions.csv

```{r knowledge_regions}
sp <- fread(file.path(dir_s05, "species_regions.csv"), colClasses = c(pool_key = "character"))
tab <- fread(file.path(dir_data_raw, "butterfly_ant_interactions", "species_table.csv"),
             colClasses = c(pool_key = "character"))
# One row per species unit (a unit may pool several rows of the parent table)
tab <- tab[, .(basis = interaction_type_basis[1],
               records = suppressWarnings(max(as.numeric(occurrence_count), na.rm = TRUE))), by = pool_key]
sp <- merge(sp, tab, by = "pool_key", all.x = TRUE)
sp[, `:=`(classified = interaction_type %in% types,
          obligate = as.numeric(interaction_type %in% c("m", "p")))]
sp[classified == FALSE, obligate := NA]

# --- 1, 2: classified species, and species-specific evidence only ---
est <- rbind(
  sp[classified == TRUE, .(estimate = "All classified species", species = .N,
                           obligate_share = mean(obligate)), by = region],
  sp[classified == TRUE & basis %in% specific_basis,
     .(estimate = "Species-specific evidence only", species = .N,
       obligate_share = mean(obligate)), by = region])

# --- 3: species recorded in well-classified hexagons ---
pres <- fread(file.path(dir_s05, "presence_hex5.csv"), colClasses = c(pool_key = "character"))
cells <- fread(file.path(dir_s05, "cell_data_hex5.csv"))
good <- cells[n_total >= min_recorded_hex & n_classified / n_total >= min_completeness]$cell_id
in_good <- unique(pres[cell_id %in% good]$pool_key)
est <- rbind(est, sp[classified == TRUE & pool_key %in% in_good,
                     .(estimate = "Well-classified hexagons only", species = .N,
                       obligate_share = mean(obligate)), by = region])

# --- 4: unclassified species imputed from classified congeners, else subfamily in region ---
genus_share <- sp[classified == TRUE, .(g = mean(obligate)), by = genus]
sub_share <- sp[classified == TRUE, .(s = mean(obligate)), by = .(subfamily, region)]
imp <- merge(merge(sp, genus_share, by = "genus", all.x = TRUE), sub_share,
             by = c("subfamily", "region"), all.x = TRUE)
imp[, value := fifelse(classified, obligate, fifelse(!is.na(g), g, s))]
est <- rbind(est, imp[!is.na(value), .(estimate = "Unclassified species imputed from relatives",
                                       species = .N, obligate_share = mean(value)), by = region])

# --- 5: upper bound with every unclassified species obligate ---
bound <- sp[, .(recorded = .N, classified = sum(classified),
                upper_bound = (sum(obligate, na.rm = TRUE) + sum(!classified)) / .N), by = region]
est <- merge(est, bound, by = "region")
write_table(est, file.path(dir_data_intermediate, "knowledge_regions.csv"))
print(dcast(est, region + recorded + classified ~ estimate, value.var = "obligate_share"),
      digits = 2)
cat("Rank correlation of the regional obligate shares with the classified-only estimate:\n")
w <- dcast(est, region ~ estimate, value.var = "obligate_share")
print(sapply(estimate_levels[-1], function(v) cor(w[["All classified species"]], w[[v]],
                                                  method = "spearman", use = "complete.obs")))
```

```{r clear_knowledge_regions, include=FALSE}
rm(list = setdiff(ls(), setup_objects))
invisible(gc())
```

# Are obligate species better sampled?

GBIF records per species (log) of obligate against facultative species, given region and lineage (random intercepts of subfamily and genus).

*Inputs:* s05/species_regions.csv; raw/butterfly_ant_interactions/species_table.csv
*Outputs:* sampling_effects.csv

```{r sampling}
sp <- fread(file.path(dir_s05, "species_regions.csv"), colClasses = c(pool_key = "character"))
tab <- fread(file.path(dir_data_raw, "butterfly_ant_interactions", "species_table.csv"),
             colClasses = c(pool_key = "character"))
tab <- tab[, .(records = suppressWarnings(max(as.numeric(occurrence_count), na.rm = TRUE))), by = pool_key]
sp <- merge(sp, tab, by = "pool_key")
d <- sp[interaction_type %in% c("f", "m", "p") & is.finite(records) & records > 0]
d[, `:=`(obligate = as.integer(interaction_type %in% c("m", "p")), region = factor(region),
         genus = factor(genus), subfamily = factor(subfamily))]
m <- gam(log10(records) ~ obligate + region + s(subfamily, bs = "re") + s(genus, bs = "re"),
         data = d, method = "REML")
cf <- summary(m)$p.table["obligate", ]
res <- data.table(response = "GBIF records per species (log10)", species = nrow(d),
                  estimate = cf[[1]], se = cf[[2]], p = cf[[4]])
write_table(res, file.path(dir_data_intermediate, "sampling_effects.csv"))
print(res, digits = 3)
```

```{r clear_sampling, include=FALSE}
rm(list = setdiff(ls(), setup_objects))
invisible(gc())
```

# Figure

Obligate share of each region estimated from all classified species, from species-specific evidence only, from the species of well-classified hexagons only, and with unclassified species imputed from their relatives; labels: share of the region's recorded species that is classified.

*Inputs:* s26/knowledge_regions.csv
*Outputs:* plot_knowledge.png

```{r plot_knowledge}
est <- fread(file.path(dir_data_intermediate, "knowledge_regions.csv"))
est[, `:=`(region = factor(region_short[region], rev(region_short[region_levels])),
           estimate = factor(estimate, estimate_levels))]
lab <- unique(est[, .(region, completeness = classified / recorded)])
p <- ggplot(est, aes(100 * obligate_share, region, colour = estimate)) +
  geom_point(size = 2.4, position = position_dodge(width = 0.6)) +
  geom_text(data = lab, aes(x = 72, y = region, label = paste0(round(100 * completeness), "%")),
            inherit.aes = FALSE, hjust = 0, size = 2.8, colour = "grey35") +
  scale_colour_manual(values = setNames(estimate_colours, estimate_levels), name = NULL) +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, 80)) +
  labs(x = "Obligate share (%)", y = NULL,
       title = "The regional ordering of obligacy is not an artefact of knowledge",
       subtitle = "Right: share of recorded species classified") +
  guides(colour = guide_legend(ncol = 2)) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 9) +
  theme(panel.grid.minor = element_blank(), panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
        legend.position = "bottom", plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
        plot.title.position = "plot")
save_figure(p, "plot_knowledge", 7, 5)
p
```

